name: @builderforce/run-guards
description: THE in-run loop-breakers every agent loop shares: the exact-repeat / circling / covered-window read guard, the repeated-failure and repeated-write tallies, edit-revert detection and the no-progress window — composed into one progress detector whose state is plain JSON, so a host that runs one step per invocation (the cloud durable loop) persists it between steps. Pure: no clock, no I/O.
